text:
erin: heads-up 1: we started seeing intermittent tool_bind_failures after today's runtime unpin in sa-east. opening thread to coordinate a scoped rollback if needed.

deploybot: [automated] action=unpin_runtime runtime=v3.7.0 scope=sa-east user=erin run_id=rb-7744 started=3012345400

cal: quick look shows ~0.7% errors concentrated on tool-heavy flows in the canary cohort. p95 latency +20ms. not global but steady for 6m.

ops-jo: options: canary pin back to v3.6.9 (fast), toggle compat-mode for handshake (config flip), or wait for SDK patch. I'd prefer canary pin then reassess.

nina: SDK team: the handshake change in v3.7.0 is optional but the default behavior changed for some clients. SDK fix ETA ~2.5h. Pin sounds safest.

phil: support: impact low but some automated integrations could fail. drafting an internal blurb.

erin: applying scoped override to avoid touching other regions. snippet Ill apply:
```
runtime_pins:
  sa-east:
    cohort: canary
    runtime: v3.6.9
```

ops-jo: executing: /deploybot pin runtime v3.6.9 --scope=sa-east --cohort=canary --reason "tool_bind_failure after unpin"

deploybot: [automated] action=pin_runtime runtime=v3.6.9 scope=sa-east cohort=canary user=ops-jo run_id=rb-7744 status=started ts=3012345655

ops-jo: pinned canary. monitoring 10m. will only roll to prod with release lead sign-off.

cal: 5m in: errors down to 0.03%, p95 back to baseline. logs show handshake failures disappear on pinned nodes.

nina: confirming SDK logs: handshake failures correlate with new default behavior in v3.7.0. PR opened for opt-out and docs update (PR #9401).

erin: plan: keep canary pin, block further unpins in change window, and run an enhanced canary preflight that hits tool-heavy paths. tag INC-7744 for postmortem and follow-ups.

phil: internal note posted. customer comms prepared but on hold pending wider impact check.

ops-jo: /deploybot summary run_id=rb-7744 actions=unpin(v3.7.0,sa-east)->pin(v3.6.9,sa-east canary) status=canary-pin duration=205s

erin: assign follow-ups: @nina SDK PR (#9401), @cal add tool-heavy preflight (INC-7744-2), @phil customer comms (INC-7744-3). closing thread for now, leaving safehold until SDK PR merges and preflight passes twice. thanks all.
